sentences.japanese: 君が次に分かることは君が新聞に載るってことだ。
sentences.english: Next thing you know, you'll be in the papers.

sentences.japanese: 君は次の昇任予定者です。
sentences.english: You are the next in line for promotion.

sentences.japanese: 君たちは次の世代の人間だ。
sentences.english: You belong to the next generation.

sentences.japanese: 君が次に話し、君は静かにしていなさい。
sentences.english: You talk next and you be quiet.

sentences.japanese: 急げば、次のバスに間に合いますよ。
sentences.english: If you hurry, you can make the next bus.
